criterion: Fiscal years per organisation never overlap, run up to 18 months, and a period lock stops postings dated inside it and only moves forward
The first fiscal year seeds the organisation's chart from BAS 2026 v1.1 (1282 accounts, 26 not-K2, 2087 = Bunden överkursfond) with the version recorded
A voucher is a draft until an explicit Bokför numbers it 1, 2, 3 per fiscal year with no gaps; a rolled-back posting returns its number
Posted vouchers and their lines reject UPDATE and DELETE; an unbalanced voucher cannot be booked (API 422, deferred constraint in the database)
Storno posts a mirrored voucher linked to the original, which reads reversed; neither can be reversed again
Underlag attaches to one draft voucher, gets its retention date on posting and is immutable afterwards
The processing history records user, time and app version, is append-only, and only bookkeeping.manage changes the books while every member reads them
